mostWorthwhile.text: Making the imagined beast was most worthwhile: rearranging familiar animal features into something new made the creative idea concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing pigment in the cave felt like a routine preparation rather than an interesting decision.

surprise.text: Completing the invented animal revealed a further goal to paint an imagined night sky.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the echo-to-song sequence made sense, although its later choices were the only gameplay actions offered.

continue.text: Yes, I would try another chapter: the imagined creature and the move from echo to shared song made familiar materials and sounds into something new.
